name: Potential Persistence Via Event Viewer Events.asp
description: Detects potential registry persistence technique using the Event Viewer "Events.asp" technique
author: GAI_CTI
query: (registry.path:(*\\Microsoft\\Windows\ NT\\CurrentVersion\\Event\ Viewer\\MicrosoftRedirectionProgram* OR *\\Microsoft\\Windows\ NT\\CurrentVersion\\Event\ Viewer\\MicrosoftRedirectionURL*)) AND (NOT ((process.executable:*C\:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\svchost.exe AND registry.path:*\\Microsoft\\Windows\ NT\\CurrentVersion\\Event\ Viewer\\MicrosoftRedirectionProgram AND winlog.event_data.Details:%%SystemRoot%%\\PCHealth\\HelpCtr\\Binaries\\HelpCtr.exe) OR (process.executable:*C\:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\svchost.exe AND registry.path:*\\Microsoft\\Windows\ NT\\CurrentVersion\\Event\ Viewer\\MicrosoftRedirectionProgramCommandLineParameters AND winlog.event_data.Details:\-url\ hcp\:\/\/services\/centers\/support?topic\=%%s) OR winlog.event_data.Details:http\:\/\/go.microsoft.com\/fwlink\/events.asp OR winlog.event_data.Details:\(Empty\)))
